base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a final high-fidelity UI design image for Remlark, a native desktop SSH/SFTP/RDP/VNC client. Entire canvas is one crisp front-on desktop app screenshot, landscape 16:10, target 1920x1200, no laptop frame, no perspective, no collage. Premium precision desktop productivity aesthetic. Restrained charcoal and warm graphite palette: canvas #111315, navigation #17191C, panels #1D2024, field #15171A, border #30343B, primary text #ECEDEB, secondary #A0A5AD, muted sage mint accent #A7DFC3 with near-black text on primary buttons; green connected, amber pending, coral danger. No neon, no purple, no gradients, no decorative hero, no giant typography. Sophisticated typography like Inter with clean Simplified Chinese, 14px body, 24px page headings, monospaced endpoints and code. Consistent 8px spacing scale, 40px inputs and buttons, 8px control radius, 12px cards and modal radius, thin 1px borders, 18px outline icons, subtle floating shadows only for overlays. UI text in Simplified Chinese, technical hostnames and protocols in English. Consistent persistent 196px left app sidebar: restrained Remlark wordmark, navigation 主机 / 工作区 / 快捷指令 / 密钥 / AI / 设置, settings at bottom, sync status at bottom. Main shell top compact titlebar. Carefully composed useful content and meaningful whitespace. No invented cloud subscription, user avatar, billing, notifications, or features unrelated to remote client. Clearly legible labels, coherent aligned controls.
